description: Adds a comment to a Notion page, to a block, or as a reply in an existing discussion. Takes exactly one of page_id, block_id and discussion_id, and the text as plain text. A new comment on a selection of text is not possible through Notion's API; a reply to an existing one is, by its discussion_id. Returns the comment's id, discussion_id, created_time, created_by, text and parent.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

block_id.description: The block's Notion id, with or without dashes, or a Notion URL that contains it (the id is read from the URL).

discussion_id.description: The discussion to reply in, from notion_get_comments.

page_id.description: The page's Notion id, with or without dashes, or a Notion URL that contains it (the id is read from the URL).

text.description: The comment as plain text. Over 2,000 characters is split into several text pieces.

name: notion-mcp__notion_create_comment
